description_en: You can invoke ListPhoneNumbers to obtain the phone number list under a specified instance
description_zh: 调用ListPhoneNumbers获取指定实例下的号码列表
kebab_example: aliyun ccc list-phone-numbers --instance-id ccc-test --search-pattern 0833 --usage Bidirection --active true --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --api-version 2020-07-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListPhoneNumbers

parameters.description_en: Performs fuzzy matching based on the number. This parameter is optional and defaults to empty. An empty value indicates no filtering.
parameters.description_zh: 根据号码进行模糊匹配，非必填，默认为空，为空表示不过滤。
